basic.connect.channel: Provide a channel to connect to.
basic.play: Loads your input and adds it to the queue.
basic.play.query: Enter a query or a searchable link.
basic.skip: Skip to the next song, or to a specific position.
basic.skip.index: Enter the position number you want to skip to.
basic.back: Go back to the previous track, or to a specific previous position.
basic.back.index: Enter the position number you want to return to.
basic.history: Show previously played songs from your history.
basic.leave: Disconnects the bot from your voice channel and clears the queue.
basic.clear: Remove all tracks from the queue or history.
basic.clear.queue_param: Select the queue you want to clear.
basic.forward: Seek forward by a given amount in the current track. Default: 10 seconds.
basic.forward.position: Enter how far to seek forward. Example: 1:20
basic.rewind: Seek backward by a given amount in the current track. Default: 10 seconds.
basic.rewind.position: Enter how far to seek backward. Example: 1:20
basic.shuffle: Shuffle the tracks in the queue.
basic.swapdj: Transfer the DJ role to another member.
basic.swapdj.member: Select the member to receive the DJ role.
basic.ping: Check whether the bot is responsive and the latency between your commands and its response.
effect.speed: Set the playback speed of the player.
effect.speed.value: The value to set the speed to. Default is `1.0`.
effect.karaoke: Use equalization to eliminate part of the frequency range, typically targeting vocals.
effect.karaoke.monolevel: The karaoke mono level. Default is `1.0`.
effect.karaoke.filterband: The karaoke filter band. Default is `220.0`.
effect.karaoke.filterwidth: The karaoke filter width. Default is `100.0`.
effect.tremolo: Create a trembling effect where the volume oscillates rapidly.
effect.vibrato: Similar to tremolo, but changes pitch instead of volume.
effect.rotation: Rotates the sound around stereo channels / headphones, also known as audio panning.
effect.distortion: Distortion effect. It can generate quite unique sound effects.
effect.lowpass: A filter that suppresses higher frequencies and passes lower ones.
effect.lowpass.smoothing: The level of the low pass filter. Default is `20.0`.
effect.channelmix: A filter that manually adjusts the audio panning.
effect.channelmix.ltl: Left to left sound. Default is `1.0`.
effect.channelmix.rtr: Right to right sound. Default is `1.0`.
effect.channelmix.ltr: Left to right sound. Default is `0.0`.
effect.channelmix.rtl: Right to left sound. Default is `0.0`.
effect.nightcore: Add a nightcore filter to your player.
effect.8d: Add an 8D filter to your player.
effect.vaporwave: Add a vaporwave filter to your player.
effect.cleareffect: Clear all or specific sound effects.
playlist.play: Play all songs from your favorite playlist.
playlist.play.name: Enter the name of your custom playlist.
playlist.play.value: Play a specific track from your custom playlist.
playlist.view: Show all your playlists and all songs in your favorite playlist.
playlist.create.name: Give a name to your playlist.
playlist.create.link: Provide a playlist link if you are creating a link-based playlist.
playlist.delete.name: The playlist name.
playlist.share: Share your custom playlist with friends.
playlist.share.name: The name of the playlist you want to share.
playlist.rename.name: The name of your playlist.
playlist.rename.newname: The new name for your playlist.
playlist.add: Add tracks to your custom playlist.
playlist.add.name: The playlist name.
playlist.add.query: Enter a query or a searchable link.
playlist.remove: Remove a track from your favorite playlist.
playlist.remove.name: The playlist name.
playlist.remove.position: Enter the position in the playlist to remove.
playlist.clear: Remove all tracks from your favorite playlist.
settings.language: Choose the bot language for this server. Bot messages will be shown in the selected language.
settings.dj: Assign or remove the DJ role.
settings.247: Toggle 24/7 mode, which prevents the bot from disconnecting due to inactivity.
settings.view: Show all bot settings on this server.
settings.togglecontroller: Enable or disable the music controller.
settings.duplicatetrack: Toggle whether YaMusic prevents duplicate songs from being queued.
settings.controllermsg: Enable or disable button-press messages from the music controller.
settings.silentmsg: Enable or disable silent messages that are sent without notifications.
playlist.permission: Manage playlist access for a user.
playlist.permission.name: Select a playlist.
settings.reset: Restore a server setting to its default value.
